title: check_csv_formula_guard.py did not credit a guard imported from a sibling module
problem: The exporter check counted a file as guarded only if the formula test (or a comment naming the risk) sat in the same file. Exporters that import their cell guard (`q` from ./csvq.mjs, `csvCell`) failed, and the only way through was pasting a comment, which also satisfies the check for an exporter that does not guard at all.
evidence: 2026-11-25 `promptctl.py measure`: platform/ci/check_csv_formula_guard.py 4 live reports in 3 days, two of them the imported-guard case (06:45, 07:24)
2026-11-25: four ai-bookkeeper exporters (projects, rental, taxdepr, taxforms) import and call q from csvq.mjs yet sat on the unguarded baseline
change: An exporter counts as guarded when it imports, by name, an export whose own definition holds the defusing formula test (guard_exports) and calls it. A guard inside a private helper of another export (greenbutton's espiToCsv) does not count. Four baseline lines removed.
metric: doc_friction entries naming check_csv_formula_guard.py and an imported guard, 7 days after merge
